Strategy: Use evenly covered charts to lift the smooth structure and g. Every maximal N-geodesic projects to an M-geodesic, which extends globally by Hopf-Rinow; path lifting uniquely lifts the extended base geodesic through its initial point, and local isometry makes the lift a geodesic. Thus N is geodesically complete, hence metrically complete. Sources: Datar §§20.1 and 24.3, pp.147–149, 178–179; Eschenburg §5, pp.17–19.
